title: Studio "Explain access": the disabled Explain button and the record Pick button give no reason on hover, keyboard focus or to assistive technology
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

## What happens
Open `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/access?surface=permission%3Ashowcase_contributor`, then open "Explain access" with no Object chosen.
- Explain is disabled, with no focusable wrapper, no `aria-describedby` and no title.
- Pick's only title is "Pick".

Reproduced on 2 fresh loads at `6091b645`.

## Mechanism
`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AccessExplainPanel.tsx`: the Explain button around line 634, and Pick around lines 607–615. This is the same class as the closed #32103, #32104 and #32105, under the `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` convention.

QA-source: #34859 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason · observed beside the clauses
